verdict.rationale: The Digits Connect API documents substantial read and write coverage of the ledger: financial statements, chart of accounts, ledger entry queries, idempotent batch transaction sync, webhooks, and a full bills workflow (ingest, approve, pay, reject, void), all described by an OpenAPI spec. Many UI features have no documented API equivalent, and the hosted MCP server is explicitly read-only, so full UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: API coverage of invoicing, dashboards, custom report building, reconciliation and month-end close actions, Ask Digits tasks, connection management, and settings/roles; an explicit parity statement; independent corroboration.
